offering_description.value: Sells a programmatic advertising software platform that lets brands and agencies buy and target digital video, TV and display ads. It earns fees on ad spend, with managed campaign services layered on top, and serves advertisers and their agencies.

primary_products.value: demand-side advertising software platform; household identity and audience data; programmatic TV advertising

primary_services.value: managed advertising campaigns; campaign analytics and measurement; audience targeting consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: brands and advertisers, advertising agencies

end_markets.value: advertising; retail; automotive; financial services; media

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: platform fees charged on advertising spend bought through the platform; service fees: managed campaign and measurement services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells its ad buying platform to advertisers and agencies that buy media; service provider: runs managed campaigns for advertisers, buying ad inventory from publishers

geography_served.value: North America: primarily US advertisers, some Canada

specialization.value: niche specialist: programmatic advertising platform and related identity and measurement tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to brands and agencies; online: self-serve platform access for advertisers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules on consumer data and tracking, such as CCPA and state privacy laws
